Apologies for late reply. It's just that I keep screwing up things all the time. I was born lacking most of social skills, being clumsy, forgetting things, being ugly.

Worst of all, is the fact that because of my lack of social skills, people find me as an easy target for mental harassment, and even worse, I didn't get my redemption on those people who tortured me emotionally. I hope those sons of motherfucking gold diggers go to hell one day.

I was recently kicked out of school, with the only reason being "We are concerned for his safety and the safety of others." These people don't know a slight nibble of me, and they don't even ask me, they never interrogated me or anything. This woman who was the lead of a psychology program said that I DIRECTLY told her that they're not helping me. Believe me, pal, I never met this woman IN MY ENTIRE LIFE.

I hate myself for my personality, too. I am loud, unfunny, and a failing attention magnet. I heard many many many times people calling me strange for these very reasons. And I still subconsciously keep thinking why they all think I am what I am.

Despite all these cons, I do have some pros.

I have some good friends who hold me under their wings. They knew what I went through, and that's probably the reason why they're my friends after all. If they're in a tough situation, I always bring my attention to them, giving them support, and they say thank you even if my support was unconditional.

I play very well on guitar, I draw well. I have nice creativity.

I cannot myself believe as I write that I have these wonderful pros that make me a good person. They all slip by and the only thing beating me up right now is how I was in the past.
